title: release(next): the Version Packages PR #21988 (18.0.0-next.0) is red in CI — check-future-spec-major and two metadata forward-conversion tests are not major-roll aware; fix on main, never on the generated branch
body:
Filing gate ③ — a maintainer-directed task. The maintainer, in this seat's session (`session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx`) on 2026-10-13, verbatim: 「21988 ci报错，你负责立卡并派发解决。」 and 「21988 是生成的，要修main 哦」.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` execution seat 1, which claims and dispatches this card. The fix lands on `main`, so the next refresh of #21988 is green. ⛔ No edit to `changeset-release/main` or #21988 by hand. ⛔ No change to a gate's or test's expectation just to make it pass. ⛔ No release action.

**Dedupe:** a semantic issue search on this repo, closed cards included, words "version PR 18.0.0-next.0 red check-future-spec-major plugin-artifact-forward-conversion current spec version major roll": 22 hits, none for these two sites. Related, not duplicates:
- #23113 (closed; the same class in the spec build's default-change ratchet, fixed by PR #23123);
- #23025 (closed);
- #23042 (open; the pre-mode `retiredAfter` guidance).

## Readings: #21988 head `63eb607ad1`, read 2026-10-13 around 03:00Z

The head carries `main` through `0d43004100`. 42 check runs; at reading time, 2 failed and 7 were still running (`Test Core (2/6)` to `(6/6)`, `Type Check · workspace`).

1. **`Type Check · source gates`**: job `115105083441`, run `38338685898`, step "Check no prose dates a change to an unreleased `@objectstack/spec` major". The step reports `✗ check-future-spec-major: 3 problem(s)`, after its own self-test passes (29 cases):
   - `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs holds 10 citation(s) above the published major, below the floor of 12`;
   - `QUOTATION_EXEMPTIONS entry 0 (docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md, major 18) matched NOTHING`;
   - `QUOTATION_EXEMPTIONS entry 1 (docs/v17-docs-sweep.md, major 18) matched NOTHING`.
   - Seat reading, not established: on this tree the gate takes 18 as the "published major". Its own self-test says "the class is DERIVED — the same corpus is green once the tree reaches 18". So the floor and the two major-18 exemptions stop matching at the roll. Whether `18.0.0-next.0` should count as published is the first question for the fix.
2. **`Test Core (1/6)`**: job `115105339463`, run `38338686006`. In `@objectstack/metadata`, `Tests 2 failed | 878 passed (880)`, both in `src/plugin-artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts`, suite "artifact door — the conversion is versioned, not a blanket amnesty (#12772)":
   - "an artifact claiming the CURRENT spec version with a NON-default retired-key value still refuses with the tombstone": `AssertionError: expected 'expected "the strict parse must refus…' to contain 'allowRestore'`;
   - "an artifact claiming the CURRENT spec version whose retired keys carry only the emitted default parses clean — the #12845 residue tolerance…": `AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to have a length of +0 but got 1`.
   - In the same job, `@objectstack/spec:test:repo` and `@objectstack/service-settings:test` end `ELIFECYCLE` with no failing test of their own in the log. The seat reads them as turbo's collateral stop; that is to be confirmed.
3. **Still running at filing:** any further red check on this head joins this card.

## What done looks like

1. Reproduce every red check on the generated tree: a fresh depth-1 clone of `changeset-release/main` at #21988's current head, the way #23113's dev did. Read the failing lines yourself.
2. Fix each on `main`, at its producer, so the gate or test is right on both sides of the roll. `main` (17.x) stays green, and the `18.0.0-next.N` tree goes green.
3. Pin: after #21988 next refreshes from a `main` carrying the fix, every check on its head is green or an expected skip. The seat reads that run.
